## Description
A clear and concise description of what the feature is.

## Use Case
Why is this important for Axiom? What does it make possible?

## Example

```text
# Axiom source here
```

## Proposed Implementation
How do you envision this being integrated? Which stages would change: lexer, parser, AST, codegen or JIT?
